ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area with approximately 15-20% coverage of high-intensity (white) pigmentation and scarring features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous patch located in the mid-lateral region of the left lobe. Discrete high-intensity punctate spots and circular rings scattered across the central and right lobes. Diffuse mottling present along the distal-lateral margin of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 90 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serration across the entire trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits higher pixel-amplitude jaggedness compared to the more rounded serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature from the median notch to the lateral tips, terminating in sharp upward-angled distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-intensity ring patterns (ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in diameter) distributed across the mid and lower regions of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct linear high-intensity disruptions visible on the dark pigmented surface of the left lobe, oriented at varying diagonal angles.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy high-intensity calcified-texture protrusions located on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes and along segments of the trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cluster of irregular high-intensity masses at the far-left and far-right fluke tips, disrupting the expected smooth geometric contour.
